# Stream Deck triggers

## Stream Deck Action

Runs when you press a key, turn a dial or tap the touch strip on a Stream Deck that has a Cuebot trigger on it. Great for turning Stream Deck keys into Cuebot buttons.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Button IDs** | The button ID you typed on the key in Stream Deck, like "ShoutOut". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to every Cuebot key and dial. |
| **Event** | What the person did. Key down is pressing a key. Key up is letting go. Dial rotate is turning a dial. Any key or dial press covers a key press, a dial press and a touch tap. Options: Any, Key down, Key up, Dial rotate, Dial press, Dial release, Touch tap, Any key or dial press. Starts as: `Key down`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%buttonId%` | The button ID of the key or dial |
| `%buttonEvent%` | What happened: keyDown, keyUp, dialRotate, dialDown, dialUp or touchTap |
| `%isDial%` | True when it was a dial, false for a normal key |
| `%ticks%` | How far the dial turned (minus means left); only for dial turns |
| `%pressed%` | Whether the dial was pushed in; only for dial events |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the Stream Deck |
| `%row%` | The key's row on the Stream Deck |
| `%column%` | The key's column on the Stream Deck |
| `%state%` | Which of its two states the key is in, 0 or 1 |

<small>Type id: `streamDeck.action`</small>

## Stream Deck Connected

Runs when the Cuebot plugin in your Stream Deck program connects to Cuebot. Handy to set key titles and pictures when the Stream Deck starts.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%instanceId%` | Which Stream Deck program connected (useful if you use more than one computer) |
| `%pluginVersion%` | The version of the Cuebot plugin in Stream Deck |
| `%streamDeckVersion%` | The version of the Stream Deck program |
| `%platform%` | The computer system it runs on, like "windows" or "mac" |
| `%deviceCount%` | How many Stream Decks are connected |

<small>Type id: `streamDeck.connected`</small>

## Stream Deck Disconnected

Runs when the Stream Deck program stops talking to Cuebot, for example when you close it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%instanceId%` | Which Stream Deck program connected (useful if you use more than one computer) |
| `%pluginVersion%` | The version of the Cuebot plugin in Stream Deck |
| `%streamDeckVersion%` | The version of the Stream Deck program |
| `%platform%` | The computer system it runs on, like "windows" or "mac" |
| `%deviceCount%` | How many Stream Decks are connected |

<small>Type id: `streamDeck.disconnected`</small>

## Stream Deck Info

Runs when Cuebot learns about the Stream Decks that are plugged in, when the plugin connects and whenever a Stream Deck is added or removed.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%instanceId%` | Which Stream Deck program connected (useful if you use more than one computer) |
| `%pluginVersion%` | The version of the Cuebot plugin in Stream Deck |
| `%streamDeckVersion%` | The version of the Stream Deck program |
| `%platform%` | The computer system it runs on, like "windows" or "mac" |
| `%deviceCount%` | How many Stream Decks are connected |
| `%deviceNames%` | The names of the Stream Decks, separated by commas |
| `%device0.name%` | The name of the first Stream Deck (device1.name is the second, and so on) |
| `%device0.type%` | The model of the first Stream Deck |

<small>Type id: `streamDeck.info`</small>
